source.name: Butterfly
source.description:
Evasion +40%，Attack Speed +20%.

Active ability: Activates upon taking damage
The bonuses provided by Butterfly are doubled for 6 seconds.
source.lore: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.
